page.notes: The woodcut initial N is a decorative ornament at the upper left of the text block, not transcribed as text. The first line reads "O Nmoechaberis." as printed; the leading O and the joining of N to moechaberis are uncertain. The Greek word after "à" is partly unclear and marked [?]. The top summary line is taken as continued from the previous page. The catchword "minis" completes the broken word "ho-" at the foot of the page. The page shows no marginal notes.
